job.rawJd: Sharecare is the leading digital health company that helps people - no matter where they are in their health journey - unify and manage all their health in one place. Its comprehensive and data-driven virtual health platform helps people, providers, employers, health plans, government organizations, and communities optimize individual and population-wide well-being through positive behavior change. Job Summary: Effectively manage ongoing relationships with clients in portfolio. Enhance and nurture existing relationships resulting in client retention and identification of upsell and add-on business opportunities, and lead streamlined internal teams to support clients and customers. Client Management: Manage high-level relationships with assigned accounts while maintaining oversight and adherence to Client SLAs. Understand and report the financial standing of services, interpret data, and make targeted recommendations for future product enhancements. Maximize existing services and identify opportunities for new or add-on services. Use technical and business-development skills to increase clients' utilization of current technology. Track, analyze, create, and deliver reports and insights. Manage ongoing and unplanned client projects and deliverables on time and within budget. Collaborate with internal departments to resolve technical and customer-service issues. Build positive relationships with clients and internal stakeholders. Own workflow assignments, resolve problems, and meet deadlines. Manage client requests for program changes. Create client profiles and Quarterly Business Reviews, gather Voice of the Customer through NPS and quarterly health checks, track add-on opportunities and financial information in Salesforce, and participate in annual client strategy and revenue goals. Contract Renewal: Participate in pre-renewal strategy meetings and support renewal strategy, packaging, presentations, negotiations, renewal and RFP responses, and accurate Salesforce records. Strategic Planning: Support plans for client retention, growth, satisfaction, QBRs, and annual reviews. Reporting: Collaborate with reporting teams to develop monthly, quarterly, and annual reports and dashboards, review reports for accuracy and client outcomes, and use Salesforce consistently and accurately. Implementation and Service Delivery: Collaborate with implementation teams on new accounts and added services, improve the implementation process, and ensure implementation activities are completed on schedule. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree required. A master's degree in business, health administration, or a clinical specialty is a plus, or equivalent work experience in business development, account management, or customer support in software or financial services. At least 3-5 years in client-facing, project-management, or account-management roles and comfort working with all levels of a business. Experience with cloud SaaS solutions or web applications. Strong professional client communication. Healthcare experience preferred. Demonstrated consultative sales and client-relationship-management abilities. Strong time management, organization, planning, prioritization, influence, expectation management, quantitative skills, initiative, judgment, decision making, and problem solving. Understanding of SaaS business strategies. Ability to travel as needed. Maintain information-governance, corporate-compliance, security, privacy, and HIPAA responsibilities. Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E-Verify users.
